text:
The constraints force Hana, Gus, and Finn into one block. Gus is immediately after Hana, and Finn is exactly two slots after Hana, so the block is Hana–Gus–Finn. Cara–Ben is a second block, and both Cara and Ben, plus Dev and Ivo, sit before that block. Ivo is at least three slots before Hana.

The only start that leaves room for those four people is Hana in 7, Gus in 8, Finn in 9. Ben must then be in 5 (so Cara is in 4): any earlier Ben is fewer than three slots from Ann, and slot 6 is too close to Gus. Ann is before Ben, at least three slots away, and exactly one slot from Dev, so Ann is in 1 and Dev is in 3. Ivo has to be before slot 5, at least three slots from both Hana and Ben, so Ivo is in 2. The remaining slot is Eve.
